# Calculate Statistic

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Calculates a statistic.

## Syntax

~~~~text
statistic(input: <#Variable (Optional)#>, operation: <#Enumeration (WFStatisticsOperation)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
statistic(input: Numbers, operation: Average)
~~~~
